name: Bean Bunker
hook: Stack baked beans to your ceiling before Downing Street panics
tagline: As the multiplier climbs, your cramped council flat fills from floor to ceiling with towers of canned beans and jugs of tap water. Cashing out slams the reinforced storm door shut with a working can opener safely in hand. If you crash, the wobbly Heinz monolith collapses under its own weight, burying the pantry in tomato sauce.
